title: ApproveResult
description: What was recorded. `nextState` is stated explicitly because it is the whole point of the decision: an approval advances the job to `final-rendering`, a rejection to `revise` and nowhere else (REQ-152, tech-spec §15 step 8).

decisionPath.description: Job-relative path to the committed ReviewDecision, e.g. `reviews/<reviewDecisionId>.json`.

nextState.description: `revise` is not a REQ-152 job state — it is the named next ACTION for a rejected draft (`cutdown revise`). Stated as a distinct value rather than reusing a state name so nobody reads a rejection as advancing the state machine.

supersededDecisionIds.description: Earlier decisions about the SAME manifest that this one now outranks. Reported rather than deleted: history is preserved, and an operator who has just overridden a colleague's call should be told so.

qaGateStatus.description: The reviewed draft's QA verdict. Null only when no report exists — which is refusable for an approval and merely recorded for a rejection.
